svg.title: Daily AI Brief Persistent Run Supervisor Architecture v3.1
svg.desc: Daily AI Brief living architecture infographic. Documentation projection only; durable machine evidence is authoritative.
svg.text: Daily AI Brief — Persistent Run Supervisor Architecture (v3.1)
Selects next eligible task and bounded
Keeps same execution identity across job
Durable State, Learning, Readiness and Projections
Every incident + root cause + actual fix
Task 00 reads full ledger and proves prior
Persistent Improvement Kanban holds future system
Task Flow — One Run, One Execution Identity
External blocker → preserve exact state and recheck
Immutable terminal runs are never reopened
Unknown side effect → recover same operation/bytes;
Owner status requests are observation only —
Run 5 is closed; image qualification is separated from the reusable hourly consumer; worker releases resume the same Supervisor execution; Kanban is Backlog/WIP/Done with timing;
route-specific blockers cannot globally pause the system; a separate Improvement Kanban captures long-term work.
Documentation projection only — durable machine evidence remains authoritative.
